{{Top|leg}}
A '''topical ointment''' was a type of medication that could be applied to a specific part of the body.

Topical ointments, alongside all-purpose [[antihistamine tablet]]s, were required for any spacers that were to visit any planets in the [[Dagobah system/Legends|Dagobah system]], including [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] itself, as a means of combating insect bites.
